machine_snapshot_reference: Shared final snapshot reference collected after individual timing runs, resource probes, and soak; it is not a claim that free-memory values were simultaneous with every candidate measurement.

collection.resource_probe: Three fixed single-turn Chinese prompts per model; sampled actual llama-server runner RSS and nvidia-smi VRAM; each runner was unloaded with ollama stop.
collection.aggregation: p50 is the median of three raw runs; p95 is nearest-rank p95 (rank ceil(0.95 * 3) = 3, therefore the maximum).

resources.overall_resource_interpretation: The lower-bounded RSS observation from the failed soak supersedes the smaller fixed-prompt-probe RSS as the relevant overall observed peak; no raw soak samples remain for independent recomputation.

llm_candidates.stability_reason: The loopback 8192-context soak was proactively stopped at approximately 431 seconds to avoid an OOM after a live runner-RSS observation of at least 7096.7 MiB and free system RAM of at most 0.46 GiB. This is a genuine memory-pressure/RSS-growth stability failure and was not retried.
notes: All three raw benchmark prompts were semantically followed.
The failed stability criterion prevents this quality model from being selected.
